entities.name: Prompt template placeholder contamination
aliases: Lesson: a placeholder in a prompt template

triples.evidence: `x3d-4.0-JSONSchema.json` (1,023,286 B, Draft 2020-12, "Experimental", SHA-1 c6765a4c...) is in the SourceForge Web3D SVN mirror.
exactly one mismatch: `NavigationInfo.@type` is typed "string" but is an MFString, so the correct array form is rejected
x3d-tidy 3.1.1 writes version 4.1 and a schema URL that does not exist.
text splat scenes above about 100k splats are rejected (libxml2 10 MB start-tag cap)
Validator limits (Confirmed at cf84f64): text splat scenes above about 100k splats are rejected

it contaminated the first free-JSON A/B arm (109 of 121 convertible scenes invented component names)
